interest: Shows SCAP's 1949 postwar farm-extension program, deploying 6,000 Japanese advisers on green bicycles to modernize agriculture.
overview: Airgram relays a 1949 press release: over 6,000 Japanese farm advisers, trained under SCAP since 1948, conduct visits and demonstrations nationwide, aided by local cooperatives and identifiable by green bicycles and armbands.

people.name: William J. Sebald
people.role: United States Political Adviser for Japan

people.name: Carl H. Boehringer
people.role: Foreign Service Officer / Drafter, USPOLAD Tokyo

subfiles.about: Transmits a Far East Command press release detailing the findings of an Agricultural Division survey on the work of newly trained farm advisers under Japan's Agricultural Extension System.
subfiles.from: United States Political Adviser for Japan (USPOLAD), Tokyo (William J. Sebald)
subfiles.summary: Airgram relays a 1949 press release: SCAP-trained farm advisers, over 6,000 strong, conduct visits and demonstrations across Japan, supported by local cooperatives and known for green bicycles and armbands.
subfiles.title: Airgram A-321 from USPOLAD Tokyo transmitting Far East Command release on Activities of Farm Advisers in Japan
